text_en: While Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly of men, women, and children gathered to him out of Israel; the people also wept bitterly.
text_cn: 当厄斯德拉泪流如注，俯伏在天主殿前祈祷认罪时，有很大的一群以色列人，男、女、孩童都聚集在他四周，民众也都流泪痛哭。

text_en: Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of the descendants of Elam, addressed Ezra, saying, “We have broken faith with our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land, but even now there is hope for Israel in spite of this.
text_cn: 当时厄蓝子孙中有一位，即耶希耳的儿子舍加尼雅，发言向厄斯德拉说：“我们由本地异民中娶了外方妇女，实在得罪了天主，但对此事为以色列还有希望。

text_en: So now let us make a covenant with our God to send away all these wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
text_cn: 现在我们与我们的天主立约， 离弃这些妇女和她们所生的儿女，全照我主和那些对我们天主的诫命起敬起畏者的意见，依照法律行事。

text_en: Take action, for it is your duty, and we are with you; be strong, and do it. ”
text_cn: 起来！因为这事全在你身上，我们支持你，你应勇敢去作！”

text_en: Then Ezra stood up and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear that they would do as had been said. So they swore.
text_cn: 厄斯德拉便起来，令司祭并肋未人和全以色列的首领起誓，必按这话去做；他们就发了誓。

text_en: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God, and went to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib, where he spent the night. He did not eat bread or drink water, for he was mourning over the faithlessness of the exiles.
text_cn: 厄斯德拉遂离开天主的殿，到了厄肋雅史布的儿子约哈南的房里，在那里过夜，饭也不吃，水也不喝，因为他对充军归来者的罪恶悲伤。

text_en: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned exiles that they should assemble at Jerusalem,
text_cn: 首领们遂在犹大和耶路撒冷发出通告，令充军归来的人都聚集在耶路撒冷；

text_en: and that if any did not come within three days, by order of the officials and the elders all their property should be forfeited, and they themselves banned from the congregation of the exiles.
text_cn: 照众首领和长老的议决：凡三日内不来者，他的一切财产应充公，他本人也应由充军归来的会众中革除。

text_en: Then all the people of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month. All the people sat in the open square before the house of God, trembling because of this matter and because of the heavy rain.
text_cn: 所有犹大和本雅明人三天内都聚集在耶路撒冷，时在九月二十日，众人都坐在天主殿前的广场上，为了这事和大雨的缘故，都战战兢兢。

text_en: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed and married foreign women, and so increased the guilt of Israel.
text_cn: 厄斯德拉司祭起来向他们说：“你们娶了外方妇女为妻而失了信，增加了以色列的罪孽；

text_en: Now make confession to the Lord the God of your ancestors, and do his will; separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives. ”
text_cn: 现今你们应向上主你们祖先的天主认罪，承行他的旨意，离开本地的异民和外方妇女。”

text_en: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “It is so; we must do as you have said.
text_cn: 全会众都高声回答说：“你怎样说，我们就怎样做。

text_en: But the people are many, and it is a time of heavy rain; we cannot stand in the open. Nor is this a task for one day or for two, for many of us have transgressed in this matter.
text_cn: 但因人民众多，又兼雨季，我们不能留在露天地里，何况又不是一两天内能完成的事，因为我们在这事上越规的人实在太多。

text_en: Let our officials represent the whole assembly, and let all in our towns who have taken foreign wives come at appointed times, and with them the elders and judges of every town, until the fierce wrath of our God on this account is averted from us. ”
text_cn: 让我们的首领为全会众负责好了！凡在我们城内娶了外方妇女的人，照指定的时候，同自己城内的长老和判官，一起前来了结此案，直到挽回我们的天主对此事的盛怒。”

text_en: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah opposed this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levites supported them.
text_cn: 只有阿撒耳的儿子约纳堂，和提刻瓦的儿子雅赫则雅，起来反对这种办法；还有默叔蓝和肋未人沙贝泰，支持他们。

text_en: Then the returned exiles did so. Ezra the priest selected men, heads of families, according to their families, each of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to examine the matter.
text_cn: 由充军归来的子民就这样作了。厄斯德拉司祭，于是由各家族为自己拣选了一些族长，都是提名指定的。他们便在十月一日，开庭审查此案，

text_en: By the first day of the first month they had come to the end of all the men who had married foreign women.
text_cn: 直到一月一日，方才办完关于娶外方妇女的男子的案件。

text_en: There were found of the descendants of the priests who had married foreign women, of the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
text_cn: 在司祭中，发现有些人娶了外方的妇女：约匝达克的儿子耶叔亚的子孙和他的兄弟中，有玛阿色雅、厄里厄则尔、雅黎布和革达里雅；

text_en: They pledged themselves to send away their wives, and their guilt offering was a ram of the flock for their guilt.
text_cn: 他们宣誓辞去自己的妻子，为赎自己的罪，献了一公绵羊作赎过祭。

text_en: Of the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
text_cn: 依默尔的子孙，有哈纳尼和则巴狄雅；

text_en: Of the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
text_cn: 哈陵的子孙，有玛阿色雅、厄里雅、舍玛雅、耶希耳和乌齐雅；

text_en: Of the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
text_cn: 帕市胡尔的子孙，有厄里约乃、玛阿色雅、依市玛耳、乃塔乃耳、约匝巴得和厄拉撒；

text_en: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
text_cn: 肋未人，有约匝巴得、史米、刻拉雅即刻里达、培塔希雅、犹达和厄里厄则尔；

text_en: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
text_cn: 歌咏者中有厄肋雅史布；守门者中有沙隆、特冷和乌黎。

text_en: And of Israel: of the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah.
text_cn: 以色列平民：帕洛士的子孙，有辣米雅、依齐雅、玛耳基雅、米雅明、厄肋阿匝尔、玛耳基雅和贝纳雅；

text_en: Of the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
text_cn: 厄蓝的子孙，有玛塔尼雅、则加黎雅、耶希耳、阿贝狄、耶勒摩特和厄里雅；

text_en: Of the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
text_cn: 匝突的子孙，有厄里约乃、厄肋雅史布、玛塔尼雅、耶勒摩特、匝巴得和阿齐匝；

text_en: Of the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
text_cn: 贝拜的子孙，有约哈南、哈纳尼雅、匝拜和阿特来；

text_en: Of the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
text_cn: 巴尼的子孙，有默叔蓝、玛路客、哈达雅、雅叔布、舍阿耳和耶勒摩特；

text_en: Of the descendants of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
text_cn: 帕哈特摩阿布的子孙，有阿德纳、革拉耳、贝纳雅、玛阿色雅、玛塔尼雅、贝匝肋耳、彼奴依和默纳舍；

text_en: Of the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
text_cn: 哈陵的子孙，有厄里厄则尔、依史雅、玛耳基雅、舍玛雅、史默红、

text_en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
text_cn: 本雅明、玛路客和舍玛黎雅；

text_en: Of the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
text_cn: 哈雄的子孙，有玛特乃、玛达达、匝巴得、厄里培肋特、耶勒买、默纳舍和史米；

text_en: Of the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
text_cn: 巴尼的子孙，有玛阿待、阿默兰、约厄耳、

text_en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
text_cn: 贝纳雅、贝狄雅、革路希、

text_en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
text_cn: 瓦尼雅、默勒摩特、厄肋雅史布、

text_en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.
text_cn: 玛塔尼雅、玛特乃、雅阿扫、

text_en: Of the descendants of Binnui: Shimei,
text_cn: 巴尼、彼奴依、史米、

text_en: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
text_cn: 舍肋米雅、纳堂、阿达雅、

text_en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
text_cn: 玛革纳德拜、沙瑟、沙赖、

text_en: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
text_cn: 阿匝勒耳、舍肋米雅、舍玛黎雅、

text_en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
text_cn: 沙隆、阿玛黎雅、约色夫；

text_en: Of the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.
text_cn: 乃波的子孙，有耶依耳、玛提提雅、匝巴得、则彼纳、雅待、约厄耳和贝纳雅：

text_en: All these had married foreign women, and they sent them away with their children.
text_cn: 以上诸人都娶了外方妇女，有的妇女也生了儿女。
